simulation_details.description: Synthetic 5 km2 urban subcatchment near Wangjiaba with CMFD daily rainfall

metrics.note: No NSE/KGE computed — SWMM urban drainage model not comparable to Wangjiaba 30630 km2 rural basin observed Q

ki_tools_used: s5_model_assembly/assemble_inp_file.py — assembled INP from CSVs (required fix for ROUTING_MODEL bug)
s6_execution/run_swmm.py — ran simulation (required workaround for sim.routing_error bug)
s6_execution/extract_results.py — extracted results (fell back to RPT parsing)
ki_tools_not_usable: s3_rainfall_forcing/convert_vic_forcing_to_swmm.py — only supports VIC ASCII forcing, not CMFD NetCDF directly
s1_subcatchment_delineation/* — requires urban GIS data not available for Wangjiaba
s2_drainage_network/* — requires pipe network GIS data not available for Wangjiaba
issues: assemble_inp_file.py uses ROUTING_MODEL instead of FLOW_ROUTING — causes SWMM ERROR 205
run_swmm.py accesses sim.routing_error which does not exist in installed pyswmm — reports false failure (exit 2) even when simulation succeeds
check_continuity_errors.py detects false-positive ERROR from column header text containing word Error
extract_results.py pyswmm Output import path issue — falls back to RPT-only extraction
2-year DYNWAVE run timed out at 5 minutes — KI does not warn about long continuous simulations
ki_gaps: BUG: assemble_inp_file.py writes ROUTING_MODEL (SWMM 4.x syntax) instead of FLOW_ROUTING (SWMM 5.x). This is a blocking error for ALL new basins — the model cannot run until manually fixed. Fix: line ~9 in opts dict, change key from ROUTING_MODEL to FLOW_ROUTING.

BUG: run_swmm.py uses sim.routing_error, sim.runoff_error, sim.quality_error attributes that do not exist in pyswmm 2.x. These were removed/renamed. The tool reports exit code 2 (failure) even when the simulation completes successfully. Fix: use try/except or check pyswmm version.

BUG: check_continuity_errors.py false-positive on lines containing the word ERROR/Error in non-error contexts (e.g., column headers like "Flow Balance Error"). Fix: only match lines starting with ERROR or in specific sections.

GAP: No tool for converting raw CMFD/MSWX NetCDF to SWMM rainfall. convert_vic_forcing_to_swmm.py only handles VIC ASCII forcing files. For new basins without prior VIC runs, users must write custom code to extract rainfall from NetCDF.
GAP: No diagnostic triplet for ERROR 205 (invalid keyword in OPTIONS). This is the first error new users will encounter due to the ROUTING_MODEL bug.
GAP: SKILL.md example INP uses ROUTING_MODEL which propagates the bug to users who copy the example.

GAP: No guidance on continuous simulation performance — DYNWAVE with daily data over multi-year periods can take >10 min for small networks. Should recommend KINWAVE for continuous or suggest event-based approach.
GAP: No tool to auto-generate a synthetic urban network from basin properties (area, imperviousness, slope). Users must manually create all CSVs. A template generator would help for new-basin setup.
